content.text:
subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source video for the target video edit: one continuous 10-second desert shot with a slow push-in from a wide shot to a medium close-up, showing a seated man reading a newspaper, a folding chair, a burning sedan, and a photo card taken from his jacket.
<Subject 1> is the adult man from <Video 1>: short gray-blond hair, black suit over a white shirt with a black tie, dark shoes, a fully visible face with no sunglasses, and the seated reading and inner-pocket behavior of <Video 1>.
<Subject 2> is the desert environment of <Video 1>: flat open sand, a level horizon, pale sky, bright diffuse daylight with short shadows, and a low-saturation warm palette, plus one tree with a slender trunk and green foliage added at the left side of the frame.
<Subject 3> is the silver-gray old four-door sedan from <Video 1>, nose facing right, with red graffiti on its rear door and trunk, in a normal, intact, undamaged state with no fire, flames, or smoke.
<Subject 4> is the thick hardcover book with a deep green cover that replaces the newspaper of <Video 1>.
<Subject 5> is the red fabric sofa with a soft cushioned seat and back that replaces the folding chair of <Video 1>.
<Subject 6> is the small black notebook with a plain black cover that replaces the white photo card of <Video 1>.

summary:
[video editing] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. In the same single continuous take, <Subject 1> reads <Subject 4> on his lap while seated on <Subject 5> in <Subject 2>, with <Subject 3> parked intact behind him and the added tree at the left of frame; around the fourth second he draws <Subject 6> from his inner jacket pocket and looks at it before returning to the book, and the burning effect on the sedan is gone.

retention_analysis:
<Video 1> (single-take structure and camera move): fully_preserved - the one continuous 10-second take and the slow push-in from wide to medium close-up are retained.
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - identity, wardrobe, seated reading posture and retrieval timing are kept, while the sunglasses are removed and the face becomes fully visible.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - terrain, horizon, sky, daylight and palette are kept, while one tree is added at the left side of the frame.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - body, color, orientation and red graffiti are kept, while all burning, flames and smoke are removed and the car stays undamaged.
<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - its lap position, held-open handling and reading use follow <Video 1>, while the object is a green-covered book instead of a newspaper.
<Subject 5> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - the seated placement and posture follow <Video 1>, while the object is a red sofa instead of the folding chair.
<Subject 6> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - the inner-pocket retrieval and the chest-height hold follow <Video 1>, while the object is a small black notebook instead of the white photo card.

detailed_description:
The target video is a direct edit of <Video 1>, keeping its realistic look, bright diffuse daylight, low-saturation warm palette, and one continuous 10-second take with no cuts.
[Shot 1] The video opens on the wide source framing of <Subject 2>, its added tree standing at the left side of the frame. <Subject 3> is parked intact and motionless on the sand directly behind the man, nose facing right, its red graffiti visible, with no flames, smoke or burn damage on it. <Subject 1> sits centered on <Subject 5> with his head lowered; his face is fully visible and unobstructed in the daylight, eyes open with no eyewear, and <Subject 4> rests open on his lap in both hands with short soft shadows under the sofa. The camera pushes in slowly from this wide framing toward a medium close-up of <Subject 1>, keeping the tree inside the left of frame. From about the fourth second he lifts his right hand to his inner jacket pocket and draws out <Subject 6>, raising it to chest height and looking down at it while <Subject 4> stays open on his lap under his left hand; a soft page rustle sounds as he turns a page, the sofa fabric creaks lightly when he shifts his weight, and a brief cloth rustle accompanies <Subject 6> leaving his pocket. He then lowers <Subject 6> and returns both hands to the book, continuing to read as the push-in settles. <Subject 3> never ignites, and the tree remains at the left of frame through the final frame.

overall_soundscape:
Dry desert wind and a faint open-air ambience continue steadily from the first frame through the last frame of the single take. No fire crackle or burning sound is present at any point.
